positive: a night vision image of a person standing or walking outdoors
a thermal infrared image of one or more human figures
a surveillance image of a person with a head, torso, arms and legs
negative: a night vision image of a wild animal
a thermal infrared image of a dog, deer or another four legged animal
a surveillance image of empty ground, vegetation or rocks
a surveillance image of water, reflections or camera noise
label_semantics: Human presence proxy; an image alone cannot establish authorization or intent.
